targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 40

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'engineering-work' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['worklog_id'])) | extend worklog=tostring(attributes['worklog_id']), feature=tostring(attributes['feature_id']), hours=todouble(attributes['hours']) | summarize arg_max(timestamp, feature, hours) by worklog | summarize developer_hours=sum(hours) by feature | sort by developer_hours desc | take 40

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize requests=count(), errors=countif(tostring(attributes['error']) == 'true'), commits=countif(metric_name == 'claude_code.commit.count'), pull_requests=countif(metric_name == 'claude_code.pull_request.count') by feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | sort by requests desc | take 40

panels.title: Feature spend by model, agent, and harness

targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']), model=tostring(attributes['model']), agent=tostring(attributes['agent.name']), harness=tostring(resource['berserk.harness.version']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 100

panels.title: Feature spend timeline and delivery milestones

targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])), commits=countif(metric_name == 'claude_code.commit.count'), pull_requests=countif(metric_name == 'claude_code.pull_request.count') by day=bin(timestamp, 1d), feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | sort by day asc | take 2000

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'engineering-work' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['feature_id'])) | summarize planned_hours=max(todouble(attributes['planned_hours'])), planned_ai_budget_usd=max(todouble(attributes['planned_ai_budget_usd'])), completion_pct=max(todouble(attributes['completion_pct'])) by feature=tostring(attributes['feature_id']) | sort by feature asc | take 100

panels.title: AI spend per actual developer hour

targets.query: let worklogs=default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'engineering-work' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['worklog_id'])) | extend worklog=tostring(attributes['worklog_id']), feature=tostring(attributes['feature_id']), hours=todouble(attributes['hours']) | summarize arg_max(timestamp, feature, hours) by worklog | summarize actual_hours=sum(hours) by feature; let spend=default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize actual_spend_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']); worklogs | join kind=leftouter spend on feature | extend ai_cost_per_hour=actual_spend_usd/actual_hours | project feature, actual_hours, actual_spend_usd, ai_cost_per_hour | sort by actual_spend_usd desc | take 100
